description: Get the top-paying companies for a job family within one country, ranked by median (p50) yearly total compensation in USD. Returns up to 10 companies with their median. Companies with too few submissions are left out. Free limit: Median (p50) total compensation for the top companies in one country. No sample size, level or years-of-experience filter. Pass canonical slugs (jobFamilySlug, locationSlug(s), countrySlug, companySlug(s)): resolve names first with search-job-families, search-locations and search-companies; never guess a slug. REQUIRED arguments: jobFamilySlug, countrySlug.

countrySlug.description: A COUNTRY location slug, e.g. "united-states", "india", "united-kingdom". Resolve it with search-locations first; cities, metros and states are rejected.

jobFamilySlug.description: A Levels.fyi job family slug, e.g. "software-engineer", "product-manager", "data-scientist".

name: search-top-companies
